tips_en: Start with the Taste-Bench paper (Paper 2) as it introduces the most novel conceptual contribution—formalizing 'taste' as a measurable quality of LLM agent decisions—and its findings that even frontier models drop sharply with longer time horizons are broadly relevant. The D-RAC paper (Paper 3) is the natural follow-up if you build agents that need better document retrieval, since improved RAG chunking directly feeds the kind of long-horizon reasoning that Taste-Bench evaluates. The OmniEdu paper (Paper 1) is more domain-specific but shares the training-data-pipeline philosophy seen in the other two.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读 Taste-Bench 论文（论文二），它提出了最具新意的概念——将「品味」形式化为可衡量的智能体决策质量，且发现前沿模型在更长时域下表现急剧下滑，这一发现具有广泛参考价值。如果你在构建需要更好文档检索的智能体，D-RAC 论文（论文三）是顺理成章的下一步，因为改进的 RAG 分块技术可以直接支撑 Taste-Bench 所评估的长时域推理。OmniEdu 论文（论文一）更聚焦于特定领域，但与另外两篇共享了「以数据流水线驱动模型能力」的核心理念。
